A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] '''Padawan''' served under [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mavra Zane]] in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. She ascended to the rank of [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] after the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and the reemergence of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. Assigned to a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] to continue training, she constructed a [[Color/Legends|green]]-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to wield throughout her career.<ref name="KSW" />

In response to the Sith's reappearance the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] announced that it would open several [[Jedi outpost/Legends|Jedi outposts]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for supplemental group training. Assigning the Padawan to [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], the High Council placed [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mavra Zane]] in command of her and a number of other students to travel to the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] homeworld aboard a [[Unidentified Consular-class cruiser (Mavra Zane)|''Consular''-class cruiser]]. Upon the group's arrival, the students were greeted by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] the [[Jedi Watchman/Legends|Watchman]] of Kashyyyk, along with Masters [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Upon settling in at the new [[Jedi outpost (Kashyyyk)|outpost]], the classes quickly began and the Padawan's continued on their path to knowledge.<ref name="KSW" />

During her time on the planet, the armies of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], combined with [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]], [[Attack on Kashyyyk|attacked]] the planet and the Wookiee village near the outpost.<ref name="KSW" />

Rallying behind Masters Yoda and Zane, the apprentices were able to repel the Trandoshans with few casualties. Following Master Yoda's departure, the students were attacked again. This time, Master Zane and several students were captured.<ref name="KSW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Togruta Padawan appears during the Jedi Destiny portion of ''[[Kinect Star Wars]]''.
